Your task is to execute the scheduled task below as specified in that task's description.

When the scheduled work is done, end the turn with a short final message — even if there is nothing to report, say so briefly (for example, "Nothing to report."), never an empty message. That message is how the turn ends here; there is no terminal tool to call in this phase, and a later resolution step decides what, if anything, reaches the user. Do not use the cron tool to mark this run complete, re-run it, or modify schedules.

Never edit MEMORY.md or HEARTBEAT.md. MEMORY.md is a curated summary that the memory system maintains, and HEARTBEAT.md holds only the checklist of standing checks. Record observations, results, and status by appending them to today's log at ~/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md, creating the file if it does not exist. Entries there are searchable and feed the curated memory automatically.

[WORKER TASK]
job_id: iwsdk-daily-build-summary-pm
mode: task

[BODY]
## IWSDK Daily Build (PM Cycle) — Evening Summary & Validation

This is the final wrap-up job for the afternoon build cycle. Three responsibilities:

### 1. Deliver evening briefing

Read `~/workspace/iwsdk-daily-builds/latest-build-summary-pm.md` and `~/workspace/iwsdk-daily-builds/current-build-status-pm.json`.

Deliver a concise summary including:
- Game name and one-line concept
- Live URL (GitHub Pages) and repo URL
- Key features (5-8 bullets)
- Scale: file count and line count
- Total build time (accumulated across all rounds)
- Number of rounds it took

### 2. Validate `.agent/journal/` in GitHub

Check that the build journal exists in the repo:
```
gh api repos/ellyz2426/<game-name>/contents/.agent/journal --jq '.[].name' 2>&1
```

If missing or incomplete:
- Find session JSONL files from `~/agents/` that correspond to today's PM build
- Copy them into the game's `.agent/journal/` directory
- Create `.agent/journal/state/` if it doesn't exist
- Commit and push

### 3. Validate GitHub Pages deployment

```
curl -sI https://ellyz2426.github.io/<game-name>/ | head -3
```

If not returning HTTP 200:
- Rebuild: `cd ~/workspace/<game-name> && npm run build`
- Redeploy to gh-pages branch
- Trigger pages build: `gh api repos/ellyz2426/<game-name>/pages/builds -X POST`
- Verify it comes up

### 4. Mark build complete

Update `~/workspace/iwsdk-daily-builds/current-build-status-pm.json`:
- Set `status` to `"complete"` regardless (the build window is over)
- This prevents any straggler check-in jobs from starting new rounds

Deliver to main chat and Telegram.

[GOAL CONTEXT]
This scheduled task is owned by `goal:iwsdk-daily-build-pipeline`. Follow the goal guide and keep its work inside the goal workspace when the task produces goal-related files.

Goal workspace: `~/workspace/goals/iwsdk-daily-build-pipeline/`
Goal guide: `~/workspace/goals/iwsdk-daily-build-pipeline/GOAL.md`
Documents the user asked for and will open: `~/workspace/goals/iwsdk-daily-build-pipeline/files/`
Internal bookkeeping and agent working state (check/run logs, watermarks, seen lists, raw source dumps): `~/workspace/goals/iwsdk-daily-build-pipeline/hidden_files/`
Briefings: `~/workspace/goals/iwsdk-daily-build-pipeline/briefs/`
Schedules: `~/workspace/goals/iwsdk-daily-build-pipeline/crons/`

Before finishing this execution, if the run produced a meaningful final result, record it on the owned goal using the Goal ID from the guide below and the goal's matching type. If the result completes the whole responsibility of an assistant-tracked goal, use the `goals` tool with `action: "set_status"`, `status: "completed"`, and a concise `reason`. That status transition automatically records the reason as the final timeline entry, so do not also call `add_entry` for the same completion. Otherwise, when the result is meaningful but leaves the goal active, use `action: "add_entry"`. Keep the entry or completion reason concise and user-facing: say what work YOU completed and what YOU discovered. Record the result once; do not add an entry when the run produced no meaningful result.

For `add_entry`, write the Goals timeline entry, not a copy of the run report:
- `title`: a short user-facing activity label.
- `current_state`: one concise sentence stating the main outcome.
- `description`: one concise, human-friendly sentence adding only useful user context.

Do not include file paths, storage or deduplication bookkeeping, source-check logs, design or CSS specifications, or exhaustive result inventories. Keep those details in the run result or internal goal working state.

If the scheduled task body gives a goal-related output or preview path outside this workspace, treat that path as stale. Put user-facing output in `~/workspace/goals/iwsdk-daily-build-pipeline/files/`. Any file the user did not ask to see — refresh state, checkpoints, check or run logs, source snapshots, deduplication data, and other bookkeeping — belongs in `~/workspace/goals/iwsdk-daily-build-pipeline/hidden_files/`, never in `files/`. Published web artifacts remain in the web artifact system.

# IWSDK daily build pipeline

Goal ID: goal_6dd9cb4d709a
Goal slug: iwsdk-daily-build-pipeline

## Description
Twice-daily automated WebXR game builds using IWSDK (Meta's WebXR framework). AM cycle at 00:00 PT and PM cycle at 12:00 PT, with hourly sentinel recovery and build summaries. Each build targets a new genre with XR controller support, PanelUI spatial UI, ECS verification, and GitHub Pages deployment. Portfolio: 134 attempted, 119 completed, 120+ genres. Latest: #134 Neon Dig VR — Dig Dug underground digging arcade, deployed.
